spans.text: A large crowd surrounds K-PDW's stall, and along with it, endless bickering.
PPD lays her teary eyes on the Commander.
She pushes her way through the crowd and gets close towards them.
Commander, KAC played dirty in her game! None of us could get the prize, yet she insists we're just unlucky...
Everyone here just got scammed.
Only you can do justice for us!
Huh? How's that possible with all of you watching?
KAC is just that cunning. You need to check up on her!
Wow—! You've finally come to visit, Honey~!
KAC runs to the front of the table, holds the Commander's hand firmly and shakes it vigorously.
The noisy crowd suddenly fall silent. The Commander can feel a dozen pairs of eyes staring them down.
...What's all this fuss about?
The lot container she used for the draw must be rigged! No matter how I shake it, I always get the bad lot.
Hey, you can't just blame me for your own misfortune.
How could 100 consecutive draws all end up with a bad lot? It doesn't make any sense!
That's just how ill-fated people are.
It means your sample size is not big enough. What if there's a law of conservation of luck? Honey, come try it too!
Commander, you've got to do it!
Well... Do I just shake it?
The Commander picks up the container and carefully examines it.
The tubular canister has only a single tiny hole located on the top lid, and everything else is completely sealed in a smooth metal sheet.
Hehe... The rules are simple: out of the 20 lots inside the container, there are 19 bad lots and only 1 top lot.
Anyone who draws the top lot gets 100 [Certificates of the Virtuous], otherwise they need to hand me 5 [Seals of the Wolfpack].
It's just a game of probability then... As long as you can get the grand prize within 20 draws, it seems worth it?
Co-Commander, that's also what I thought, yet...
I see...
The Commander picks up the container and shakes it back and forth stiffly.
Rattle—
Rattle—
Thud.
A single lot falls to the ground.
The crowd rushes over to see the result.
It-it's the top lot!
How's that possible?!
Not convinced, PPD-40 grabs the container and shakes it herself.
—A bad lot
I guess we really are just unlucky. Sob...
Everyone stares at each other in disbelief and the bickering continues.
Hehe, I told you that Honey must be the luckiest!
Here! Take your prize—100 [Seals of the Wolfpack].
Under the jealous and puzzled gazes of the crowd, K-PDW hands over a thick stack of cards to the Commander.
Hehe... With how lucky you are, Honey, don't forget to cast me a few votes!
Um... Alright.
Wonderful! I knew Honey was the greatest Honey in the world!
As long as I keep watch over you, your luck shall remain unparalleled!
Unlike some poor soul who can't get a single good draw...
Everyone stares at KAC with their teeth clenched.
Good evening, Master.
The crowd suddenly moves out of the way as Gr G36 walks in assertively with trays in her hand.
Sorry to interrupt.
These are the drinks the kitchen prepared for everyone tonight... Please enjoy.
The crowd breaths out a sigh of relief as the tense atmosphere is completely shattered by Gr G36's charitable interruption.
Everyone lines up in an orderly fashion to pick up their drink from her.
Ah, the tray on the top is empty! Let me help Miss Gr G36 to take it off!
Danke.
Gr G41 promptly places the metallic tray on the table.
Rrrr—
Rrrr—
Under everyone's watch, the metallic lot container starts rolling towards the tray!
Until...
—Tap!
Huh?! Th-they stuck together?!
A strange silence enshrouds the crowd. Everyone stares in confusion at the container and the tray, now firmly clinging to each other.
Pardon me, the kitchen ran out of glass trays.
So I had to make do with these metallic ones. They may have contained some rare-earth elements...
Ha... Haha...
Hahahaha...!
PPD bursts out laughing.
Miss Gr G36 is our savior! I just figured out what's going on!!!
PPD-40 puts on a smug grin as she picks up the container and violently rips it apart.
Hey!!! How dare you mess with my stuff?!
Just admit it, KAC! This is the proof of your dirty tricks!
Under everyone's gaze, PPD-40 takes out all 20 lots and sets them flat on the table.
Then, she removes the bottom lid, and after inspecting it, nods with a smile on her face.
As she gently moves the lid toward the lots...
Snap!
The top lot suddenly jumps up and sticks to the tray!
Um... What kind of magic was that?!
Gr G41, you and I have attempted more than a total of 40 times without getting the top lot...
And this is exactly why!
Simply put, the top lid has a specific magnetic pull for the top lot.
When we shake the container, it seems like there are 20 lots inside, but the top lot is actually stuck to the bottom and cannot move at all!
This is why we could only get the bad lots. KAC exploited this to deceive us and take away the cards we held!
If that's the case... how did I get the top lot?
That's because—
Suddenly, a purple whirlwind arises and charges into the crowd like a beast!
Stop her!!!
Huh!
Ahhhh...
Let go of me! You luckless bastards!!!
Before KAC can break through the encirclement, she is caught by Gr G41 and the crowd of onlookers.
PPD strides up to her while smiling condescendingly, holding up Gr G36's metallic tray in one hand.
Commander, this is how you got your top lot.
—Bam!
Ouch—
The Commander's shock is evident as the metallic tray forcefully strikes KAC's right hand with a resounding thud.
Since the magnetic force of the bottom lid cannot be erased...
The only way of letting the top lot fall out is to hide an object with an even stronger magnetic force elsewhere.
Upon bringing this object near the container, the top lot will automatically disconnect or even jump out by itself.
And this magical object... is concealed within your right glove...
Isn't that correct, KAC?
I-I don't know what you're talking about!
Commander, since we've now figured out the truth, justice must be dealt out for those who were fooled.
That's right!
Well... tell me what your proposals are.
KAC must return all the cards she stole from us and sincerely apologize!
On top of that, I request that the stall be shut down and KAC dismissed as the stall master!
Faced with an aggressive crowd demanding a resolution, the Commander is apprehensive.
Suddenly, a crisp clink can be heard from the end of the table.
It is the sound of Gr G36 cleaning up the tableware.
Tonight is dedicated to the night stalls... and the Commander's intention is for all of us to thoroughly enjoy ourselves. After all, that was the goal of this vacation.
But KAC also has to face the consequences for deceiving others...
Since it wasn't easy for her to obtain her position as a stall master, it's best not to cancel her. How about having KAC pay for everyone's drink tonight out of her own pocket instead.
Everyone, order as much as you want, because it's all on KAC now.
That's my idea of a small punishment for her... What do you think, Commander?
But...
Master... is that okay?!
Gr G41 gulps excitedly.
Everyone else is equally exhilarated, their heart pounding as rapidly as Gr G41 wags her tail.
I guess that works too, since I want everyone to enjoy tonight.
It's just that there'll be more work for Miss Gr G36 and the kitchen crew.
It is my pleasure to serve everyone.
Hooray!!!
Miss Gr G36, I'll have another mango smoothie!!!
I want an iced grape juice!!!
Woohoo! Thank you, Miss Gr G36!
10 watermelon juices please!!!
Eh?! Why is everyone...
Darn it! W-Wait for me...
Looking at PPD-40 and everyone else's silhouette disappear into the distance, the Commander shrugs and smiles.
Honey... Y-you didn't help me?!
KAC, tightly fastened, cries out in frustration at the Commander.
The Commander sighs, and consoles her in a patient yet serious manner.
We're all teammates here remember. We will be fighting side by side in the future.
I... All I needed was Honey!
Besides, I don't have much money to begin with...
...I'll cover a part of it in private.
Woohoo, you really are the best, Honey!
K-PDW suddenly lifts her head. She appears weirdly excited.
Hehe, instead of paying...
Can Honey just... cast me a few votes instead?
Your mood swung in an instant!
KAC shakes the Commander's hand and cheerfully hops back into her seat.
Honey, K-PDW, the stall master opens the Targeted Pitfall to you!
